item: The native libraries a session ran on are kept in the sentinel and reported beside the crash trace
summary: libxml2/libxslt runtime and compiled-against versions, the SQLite library, installed versions of the extension packages and the base names of the mapped shared objects of the families worth naming (never a directory; byte-budgeted list with the matched count stated) are read at each start; the previous-session report carries them because faulthandler names Python frames only.
